title: The indicator's copy and icon stop implying a single cause
outcome: The 待送 condition shows a static offline icon instead of a spinner that lies about work in progress, and its popover text says one of two different things depending on whether the browser reports a connection -- instead of one sentence that used to cover both.
acceptanceCriteria: A `useIsOnline` hook is added via `useSyncExternalStore`, with its `subscribe` function defined once at module scope so the reference passed to `useSyncExternalStore` is stable across renders, and `getServerSnapshot` returning `true` because Next.js still server-renders this client component and the server has no `navigator`.
In the 待送 condition (`attempts >= 2`), the persistent icon is the static `RiCloudOffLine`, replacing the `Spinner` that condition previously showed.

The popover sentence for 待送 is two lines: 'N 筆已保存' followed by '恢復連線後自動送出' when `useIsOnline()` is false, or '會持續嘗試送出' when it is true -- `navigator.onLine` plays no part in which of the five conditions is chosen, only in picking this copy.

The 無法保存 condition names the quota -- `本機空間已滿` -- and its second line branches on whether any other game still has unsent entries, since sending those is what frees the space. It does not read `useIsOnline()`: the network has nothing to do with a store that cannot hold anything.
The button's `aria-label` carries the full two-line sentence for whichever condition is showing, not just the short badge count.
The persistent layer outside the popover is unchanged in shape: icon plus count badge; only the icon choice and the popover's internal text layout change.
